w: Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals for the abhishek murti of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Then Swamishri attended the BAPS Centenary Celebration assembly. He was welcomed by thousands of flag-waving devotees. In his blessings Swamishri appreciated and blessed the devotees of the New York mandal. The Council Member of New York City Mr Hiram Monserrate sent a letter of citation to honour Swamishri. At 8.00 pm Swamishri departed from New York mandir and travelled to East Brunswick to preside over and bless the 2½-day National Leadership Seminar for leading BAPS volunteers. The shibir theme was ‘Sanstha, Siddhant and Satpurush’.

The highlight of this evening assembly’s programme was a drama based on the story of Nachiketa written by Aksharvatsal Swami. Swamishri praised the theme and drama performance by youths of Ahmedabad. In his blessings Swamishri elaborated upon the glory of God and his all-doership.
